step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows an automated, multi-account sensitive data discovery and remediation pipeline using Amazon Macie. First, production S3 buckets in multiple AWS accounts (represented by Top Right and Bottom Right accounts) are scanned by Macie. Second, Amazon Macie (Main) aggregates these findings and exports the discovery metadata into a central S3 Findings Bucket. In the analytics and reporting workflow, Amazon Athena queries the metadata directly from the findings bucket, and AWS Glue runs ETL processes to load and aggregate findings into a custom MySQL data lake. Finally, Security Engineers use Amazon QuickSight (and other BI tools) powered by Athena queries to visualize and prioritize risk, allowing them to collaborate with data owners for remediation.

graph.name: Opportune Automated Sensitive Data Discovery and Remediation with Amazon Macie
graph.notes: An AWS Organization-wide data discovery posture management (DSPM) architecture. Macie scans S3 buckets across multiple member production accounts, centralizes discovery metadata in an S3 findings bucket, runs Athena and Glue ETL to populate a MySQL data lake, and visualizes top-risk buckets using Amazon QuickSight.
